common_name: Silurian Trilobite Holaspid Morphotype I (18 Thoracic Segments)

phenomenon_scale.label: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength
phenomenon_scale.note: 15 µm detail scale is stored as 1.549e-05 m (15.49 µm). This is not the 544 µm primordium-scale sibling slot and not the millimetre body length.

equations.linear_system: du/dt = D_u lap u + f_u u + f_v v; dv/dt = D_v lap v + g_u u + g_v v
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
turing_conditions: (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)^2 > 4 D_u D_v det(J)
equations.saturation: cubic -u^3 on the activator closes the linear instability

parameters.boundary_condition: periodic Fourier domain on one thoracic pitch; zero-flux is not used

chronoseries_reconstruction.method: Longest contiguous run of Sobel row-energy above the 62nd percentile, divided by image height, on the pinned 14 mm Commons photograph. The same fraction is applied to the published characteristic lengths of the meraspis and holaspis22 stages because the species_gallery JPEGs of those stages are byte-identical to each other and are not independent specimens.

specimen.creator: Dwergenpaartje
specimen.description: Aulacopleura konincki, 14 mm, Order Proetida, Family Aulacopleuridae, Kosovu Beruna, Czech Republic, Silurian

empirical_claims: Hughes and Chapman (1995) and Fusco et al. (2004) document continuous meraspid segment addition and a variable holaspid thoracic number in Aulacopleura konincki, including an 18-segment morphotype.
Fusco, Hong and Hughes (2016) measure axial growth gradients along the postprotaspid trunk; segment pitch is not uniform.

The 15.49 µm wavelength is the assigned cellular-scale Turing wavelength for this slot. The pinned photograph resolves pleural ribs at hundreds of micrometres and does not resolve a 15 µm ocellus lattice.
